verdict.rationale: Cal.com provides webhooks (event-triggered automations like BOOKING_CREATED, RESCHEDULED, CANCELLED), a full API/MCP server for AI agents to check availability and create bookings, and workflows are mentioned in docs — enabling background automation without human intervention. However, evidence centers on event-driven/reactive triggers (webhooks fire on booking events) and agent-invoked actions rather than a native scheduled/cron-style 'run autonomously on a timer' automation builder, and there's no hands-on confirmation of long-running unattended agent workflows in production. missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated scheduled/cron automation engine (vs event-triggered webhooks only), independent/hands-on proof of autonomous background execution over time, and detail on the 'workflows' feature's automation depth.
